description: This file defines a Spring MVC Controller class 'FilesController' that handles HTTP requests related to serving static files and downloadable product files in an e-commerce web application. It includes methods for retrieving files based on store code and filename, with some methods secured for admin roles.

classes.name: FilesController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller that provides endpoints for serving static files and product downloads, extending AbstractController.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles GET requests to serve static files for a specific store, based on store code, filename, and extension.

methods.name: downloadProduct
methods.description: Handles GET requests, secured for roles 'PRODUCTS', to serve downloadable product files with attachment disposition.
